zh.eyebrow: 从一个方向开始，让能力慢慢生长
zh.chooseHint: 看看日常会做什么，选一个感兴趣的方向开始。之后随时可以调整。
zh.overviewTitle: 从这里，培养你的职业能力
zh.overviewHint: 每条枝干是一组能力。选一枚芽苞开始学习，通过检验后，它会长出新叶。
zh.nextTitle: 下一步，可以从这里开始
zh.willGrow: 通过检验后，这枚芽苞会长出新叶。
zh.alreadyGrown: 这项技能已通过检验，新叶会一直留在这里。
zh.savedGrowth: 新叶已留在左侧对应的芽梢。你可以继续学习，也可以看看整树的变化。
zh.branchGrowth: 本枝技能已全部通过。新叶与返绿的枝干会一直保留。
zh.growthNote: 阅读和练习记录过程；通过检验才会长叶。
zh.chooseBranch: 也可以从一条枝干开始
zh.noRecords: 还没有学习记录，从喜欢的一项开始就好。
zh.allDone: 这棵树已完成全部技能检验，可以回顾成果或探索新的方向。

en.eyebrow: Choose a direction. Give your skills room to grow.
en.chooseTitle: What would you like to explore first?
en.chooseHint: See the work and skills involved, then try a direction that interests you. You can change it anytime.
en.overviewTitle: Give your career skills room to grow
en.overviewHint: Each branch is a set of skills. Choose a bud to start learning. Pass its check to grow new leaves.
en.resumeTitle: Pick up where you left off
en.willGrow: Pass this skill's check to grow new leaves on this bud.
en.alreadyGrown: You have passed this skill's check. Its leaves are here to stay.
en.leafComplete: Your skill has grown new leaves
en.savedGrowth: New leaves now mark this skill on the left. Continue learning or take a look at the whole tree.
en.branchGrowth: Every skill on this branch has passed. Its new leaves and green wood are here to stay.
en.growthNote: Reading and practice record your process. Passed checks grow leaves.
en.noRecords: No learning records yet. Start with a skill that interests you.
en.allDone: You have passed every skill check on this tree. Revisit your work or explore another direction.
